title: AI Transforms Modern Healthcare
author: Dr. Anita Sharma
snippet: Artificial Intelligence is making rapid progress in diagnosing diseases and assisting doctors.
content: Artificial Intelligence is transforming the landscape of modern medicine. From faster diagnostics to AI-driven robotic surgeries, the industry is experiencing a major shift.

title: Nepal Government Introduces Digital ID
author: Ramesh Thapa
snippet: The new National Digital ID will replace old paper systems across Nepal.
content: In a bid to digitize public services, the Nepal Government has launched a new national digital ID system. Citizens can now verify and access documents online securely.

title: 10 Easy Yoga Poses for Beginners
author: Sita Rai
snippet: Start your health journey with these simple and effective yoga poses.
content: Yoga offers physical and mental benefits. These 10 beginner-friendly poses help improve posture, flexibility, and reduce stress levels.

title: Must-Visit Places in Pokhara
author: Kiran Adhikari
snippet: Discover the serene beauty and culture of Pokhara, Nepal's lake city.
content: Pokhara is one of Nepal's top travel destinations. From the peace pagoda to boating on Phewa Lake, there's something for every traveler to enjoy.

title: Inflation Rate Drops for Third Month
author: Manish Neupane
snippet: Consumer prices continue to fall after the central bank's intervention.
content: Inflation rates have seen a consistent drop, marking a positive turn in the economy. Experts believe this may open the door to reduced interest rates.

title: 5 Best Mobile Apps for Productivity
author: Nirajan Poudel
snippet: Boost your daily tasks with these top-rated productivity apps.
content: Mobile apps like Notion, Trello, and Todoist are helping millions stay organized. These apps come with smart features that simplify project tracking and time management.

title: Budget 2025 Focuses on Youth Employment
author: Pratiksha Regmi
snippet: The new budget introduces skill-based programs to reduce youth unemployment.
content: Nepal's Budget 2025 includes several youth-focused initiatives such as entrepreneurship training and micro-loans for startups to address the growing unemployment rate.

title: Top 7 Immune-Boosting Foods
author: Dr. Binita Karki
snippet: Strengthen your body’s defense system with these nutritious foods.
content: Including foods like citrus fruits, garlic, and turmeric in your diet can boost your immune system. Experts recommend natural foods over supplements when possible.

title: Everest Base Camp Trek Guide
author: Deepak Maharjan
snippet: Plan your EBC trek with this detailed beginner-friendly guide.
content: The Everest Base Camp trek is one of Nepal’s most iconic adventures. This guide covers routes, acclimatization tips, gear checklist, and best seasons to visit.

title: Stock Market Sees Sudden Surge
author: Rajesh Bhattarai
snippet: Market gains reflect positive investor sentiment and economic recovery.
content: The stock market experienced an unexpected surge this week. Analysts credit government policy changes and rising consumer confidence as major factors.
